title: Understanding PCA Components
text: In PCA, we often refer to the principal components. These are essentially the directions in which the data varies the most. When plotting, we usually focus on the first few components.

title: Identifying the Correct Term
text: Think about the structure of a dataset. It consists of rows and columns. Which of these do you think represents the principal components in PCA?

title: Choosing Between Rows and Columns
text: In the context of PCA, the principal components are derived from the features of the dataset. Features are typically represented as what in a dataset?
